jev.source: TypeSafe AI public pricing: $42 per billion input tokens; output free.

gpt-5.6-sol.source: OpenAI API standard short-context pricing; promotional Sol pricing applies in the current pricing window.

korgis-local.source: No per-token provider API fee for local Korgis inference. Hardware, electricity, amortisation and opportunity cost are excluded.

notes: OpenAI values are for standard processing and short context (<272K input tokens).
Regional processing or other service tiers can change effective cost.
The benchmark records the pricing snapshot date in every run manifest.
Provider prices can change; historical benchmark reports must keep the snapshot used for that run.
GPT-5.6 Sol pricing in this snapshot reflects the promotional standard API price current on 2026-09-20.
Korgis local API cost is recorded as zero provider fee only; this is not a claim of zero total cost of ownership.
